# IQWealth — iraqsm.com

> Live prices, interactive charts, indices, and bilingual (Arabic/English) company profiles for every stock on the Iraq Stock Exchange (ISX). Tracks the RSISX index, market movers, trading volumes, and per-company history. اسعار الاسهم العراقية مباشرة، سوق الاسهم العراقي، بورصة العراق.

Iraqsm.com is a free Iraq Stock Exchange (ISX) market tracker. Prices and OHLC data originate from the ISX portal and Rabee Securities (RSISX); long-range historical closes are corporate-action adjusted (dividends, capital increases). Currency is the Iraqi Dinar (IQD). Content is available in Arabic (default) and English.

## Main pages

- [Home — market overview](https://iraqsm.com): RSISX index, gainers/losers, and the full list of ISX-listed companies with live prices.
- [Market](https://iraqsm.com/market): Full searchable/sortable table of all ISX stocks by sector, price, change, and volume.
- [Charts](https://iraqsm.com/charts): Interactive index and stock charts (1D to 5Y and since-2015), with RSI and moving averages.
- [Banks](https://iraqsm.com/banks): The ISX banking sector — the largest group of listed companies.
- [Currency (IQD/USD)](https://iraqsm.com/fx): Iraqi Dinar to US Dollar rates and converter.
- [Gold](https://iraqsm.com/gold): Gold prices in Iraq.
- [News](https://iraqsm.com/news): Iraqi economy and market news.
- [Research](https://iraqsm.com/research): Market research and analysis.
- [Learn](https://iraqsm.com/learn): Educational guides on investing in the Iraq Stock Exchange.
- [About](https://iraqsm.com/about): About iraqsm.com.

## Company pages

Each listed company has its own page at `https://iraqsm.com/c/{TICKER}` with a live price, OHLC candlestick chart (multiple timeframes), trading volume, market cap, and a bilingual company profile. Examples:

- [TASC — Asiacell Communications (Telecom)](https://iraqsm.com/c/TASC)
- [TZNI — Al-Khatem Telecommunication / Korek (Telecom)](https://iraqsm.com/c/TZNI)
- [BBOB — Bank of Baghdad](https://iraqsm.com/c/BBOB)
- [BMNS — Al-Mansour Bank](https://iraqsm.com/c/BMNS)
- [IBSD — Baghdad Soft Drinks (Industry)](https://iraqsm.com/c/IBSD)
- [BNOI — National Bank of Iraq](https://iraqsm.com/c/BNOI)
